The figure on the far right has indistinct limbs and instrument boundaries. The guitar neck seems to merge with the body/arm, and the legs lack clear definition against the background.
While some blur is expected due to depth of field or motion, the faces and hands of the background musicians exhibit a 'smudged' quality typical of AI generation rather than optical blur.

To verify the anatomical correctness of the human figures (limbs, fingers) holding instruments, checking for common AI errors like extra arms or fused fingers.
To ensure the lighting rig hangs logically above the stage and foreground monitors sit correctly in front of the stage plane without spatial bleeding.
To check if guitars/drums are distinct objects or if they fuse with the musicians' bodies, and if cables form continuous paths.
